text: Coffee with Tamar after the all-hands. Her manager Reggie is leaving at the end of the month and she's been asked to cover his clients. She seems quietly thrilled. Leaving drinks are Oct 30, I said I'd go. Reggie's wife Bethany is apparently relieved, he's been doing sixty-hour weeks since the spring. Tamar wants to pitch for his role properly in January.
Eilidh's daughter starts primary on September 2nd. Eilidh is more nervous than the kid is. Should text her that morning to see how drop-off went.

Long call with Pooja. Her brother Aarav graduates from Edinburgh on June 3rd and the whole family is flying up the day before. She wants to get him a decent fountain pen but has no idea about brands. Pooja's still at the consultancy, still hates the commute. Ask her afterwards how the ceremony went.

Meera ran the half marathon Sunday, 2:04, a PB by six minutes. Her husband Kemal had a sign and everything. Send congrats. She's aiming for London in April now, ballot result comes out next week. Kemal says she's already looking at training plans.
Natasha and Tobi are doing a recital together 11/22, piano and cello. Tobi has been practising till midnight apparently. I've already bought tickets for me and Hannah.
Bumped into Louis outside the office. Client presentation went badly yesterday, the Morris account. He's worried his review next week will reflect it. Check in with him Friday.
Lola's lad Jun sat his driving test this morning. Passed first time! Lola cried in the car park apparently.
Jada is in the regional chess final on April 12. Her dad says she's barely sleeping. Don't forget to text her good luck the night before, and ask her how it went the next day.

Dinner with Hemi and Uma. They're off to Lisbon for their tenth anniversary, March 8 to the 15th. Uma is coeliac so they've been researching restaurants for weeks. Hemi wants a film camera, she let that slip when he was in the loo.
Tadhg's band has a gig at the Lexington on Saturday. First one since their drummer quit. Must go, bring earplugs.
Kiara's son Yaw got his GCSE results. Eight 9s. She was trying to be modest about it and failing.
Phoebe got passed over for the team lead role. Went to Emily Walsh from accounts instead. Phoebe says she's fine but she clearly isn't. I should take her for lunch next week.
Pick up dry cleaning, renew parking permit, book the boiler service for Nov 4.
Bethany's school play is 12/10, she's the Grinch. Her mum Katarzyna says she knows everyone's lines, not just hers. Rehearsal the day before runs late so no visiting then.
Quick one: Sadia's PhD viva got moved to January 14th. She's relieved to have the extra time. Remind me to message her the week after.
Anil mentioned his wife Zeynep is doing the London Triathlon in August. He's training with her on weekends even though he hates swimming. He's a vegan now too, which explains the lunch thing.
Call with Marta re the Dubois contract. Her boss wants it signed by May 14. Marta thinks the client will push back on pricing. Nothing for me till the draft lands.

Ines finished her nursing degree! Graduation is July 18th at the cathedral. Her partner Aidan is organising a surprise dinner afterwards. Get a card and something small, she likes those succulent kits.
Erin's mum is having her hip done on 2/6. Erin is taking the week after off to look after her. Ring Erin the day after the op.
Hannah said Reggie got the promotion. Regional director from November. He's taking the whole team out on the 7th to celebrate.
Kemal's football team made the cup final, kick-off 3pm on May 20th. His kids Lola and Tobi go to every game. Kemal is being superstitious about the same socks.
Gig cancelled. Natasha says the venue flooded, so no Fontaines on Thursday. She's gutted.
Uma's daughter starts reception this week. Uma went back to work the same day, felt awful about it. Text her on Friday to see how the first week went.
Reminder for me: dentist on the 9th at 8:40, then straight to the station.
Pooja's sister-in-law is pregnant, due around 6/25. Pooja is going to be an aunt for the first time and can't stop talking about it. She's knitting, badly.
Met Yaw's new manager, Dr Khan, at the client lunch. Bit intense. Yaw says she's fair though. Yaw is up for a promotion review in the spring.

Tamar's moving to the Bristol office in January. Her girlfriend Katarzyna got a job at the university there and starts January 8th. Tamar is anxious about telling her team. She wants to do it the week before Christmas. Should offer to help her with the handover doc.
Meera's daughter has her grade 5 piano exam on March 3rd and is terrified. Meera is practising scales with her every evening. Send a good luck message that morning.
Aidan has a dog now, a rescue greyhound called Biscuit. Spent most of the call showing me photos.

Kiara and her husband Louis are hosting a christening for baby Ines on the 21st. They've invited about forty people. Kiara is stressed, Louis is not, which is the problem apparently. Ask if they need chairs. Kiara's mum is flying in from Nairobi the day before and staying a fortnight, which may or may not help. The baby has finally started sleeping through, so at least there's that.
Hemi's last day at the agency is Friday. Twelve years. Leaving do at the Crown that evening. Chip in for the collection before Thursday.
Emily's son Aarav got into Leeds for medicine. Results came through this morning. She rang me before she even rang her mum.
Jada says her dad Anil is having tests next week, something with his heart. She's putting on a brave face. I should check in with her after the results, and not before.
Lola told me Tadhg proposed at the Glastonbury gig. She's been asked to be maid of honour. Wedding is probably next summer, they're thinking August 9.
Natasha likes those weird indie board games. Christmas idea.

Erin and Jun did the 10k on Sunday morning. Jun walked the last bit with a calf strain. Erin finished in 51 minutes and is now insufferable. Ask Jun how the leg is doing. They're already talking about the Bath half on March 15th, which feels optimistic. Erin wants us all to sign up together and has started a group chat for it.

Louis says the Nguyen client is threatening to walk. Big meeting with them on 4/2, he and Sadia are presenting. Sadia is new and pretty nervous about it. Text Sadia good luck the day before, then catch up with Louis afterwards.

Tobi's nan turns 90 on Dec 5th. Big party the Saturday after at the cricket club. Tobi wants everyone to bring a photo. Find one from the wedding. Tobi said his nan still swims three times a week and beat him at Scrabble last Christmas. She's into crosswords and Agatha Christie, so a nice hardback might be a good present.
Marta's twins started secondary school yesterday. One loved it, one came home in tears. Marta is torn up about it.
Eilidh's partner Hemi has a new job at the hospital, starts November 3rd. Eilidh says he's been bored at the council for years. Wish him luck that weekend.
Phoebe's partner Tadhg ran the Dublin marathon on 10/26. Phoebe and their kids followed him round on the bikes. He finished, barely, and hasn't walked properly since.
Kemal, aka Kem, is in the five-a-side league final on 6/14. Team of dads versus team of twenty-year-olds. He reckons they'll lose but he's pumped.
Planned my week: Monday quarterly review, Wednesday the client workshop, Friday off. Need to book the train for Wednesday morning.
Zeynep's son Jun has his first day at nursery on Sept 8th. She's going back to work part time the same week. Both of them nervous. Pop round with a coffee the day after.
Bethany says her boss is leaving and the whole team is getting restructured. Meeting with HR on Monday. She's anxious, she's only been there eight months. Ring her Monday evening.
Uma loves Japanese whisky and has started collecting. She mentioned a Hibiki bottle she wants three times tonight, so that's her birthday sorted. Birthday is 1/19.
Aarav's school concert is on May 22. He's doing a trumpet solo. His mum Pooja says he practised in the shed for weeks so the neighbours wouldn't complain. I'm driving them there.
Katarzyna said the wedding is off. She and Louis split up last month. She's staying with her sister Ines for now. Check in on her next week.
Quiet chat with Anil. Not much new. He's still at the bank, still cycling to work, still allergic to everything.
Reggie's daughter graduates from Durham on June 27th. He's booked a hotel for the night before and the night after. Proud dad mode. Ask him for photos afterwards.
Ines is running the Great North Run on September 13. She's raising money for the hospice that looked after her dad. Sponsor her before the 13th, and text her that morning.
Jada's GCSEs start May 11. Her mum Erin says she's been revising since Easter. Jada's dog Pickle sleeps on her notes.
Dr Evans, Tamar's old supervisor, is retiring at the end of term. Tamar is organising a surprise do on 7/15 and roping me in. She wants a speech from me, which: no.
Hannah's baby is due on 3/30. She's finishing work March 1st. Her husband Yaw is painting the nursery this weekend. Send her the bag of hand-me-downs.

Eilidh got the part! Lady Macbeth in the amateur production, opens Nov 13, runs three nights. She'd auditioned twice and nearly gave up after the first. Book tickets for opening night, and flowers for afterwards.
Grocery run, then the post office. Passport photos before the 20th.

Long catch-up with Zeynep and Phoebe at the pub. Zeynep's boss finally signed off her sabbatical, she's going to Japan for three months from April 1st. Phoebe is applying for a design role at the Thomas agency, interview on 3/12, and is nervous because she's never done a portfolio review. Zeynep's cat Pasha is going to Phoebe while she's away. We're doing a send-off dinner the week before Zeynep leaves. Text Phoebe good luck the morning of the interview.
Marta's son Tadhg got his black belt on Saturday after four years. Grading took two hours. She filmed the whole thing.
Natasha's moving flats on the 28th, the one near the park. Her brother Kemal is borrowing a van. I said I'd help with boxes that morning.

Lunch with Kiara, Meera and Sadia. Kiara's work is relocating to Manchester in spring and she's not sure she'll go. Meera's son Louis has his first football match for the county under-12s on Nov 8th. Sadia is training for her first triathlon and loves it more than she expected. Don't forget to ask Meera how the match went the next day.
